title: 2011 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: Josanna’s test scores to date are \(90,\) \(80,\) \(70,\) \(60,\) and \(85.\) Her goal is to raise her test average at least \(3\) points with her next test. What is the minimum test score she would need to accomplish this goal?

solutions.text:
The five scores sum to \(90+80+70+60+85=385,\) giving an average of \(77.\) The goal is a new average of at least \(80.\)

Six tests averaging \(80\) must total \(6\cdot80=480,\) so the sixth score must be at least \(480-385=95.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Find the current average of the five scores
The six scores must total \(6\) times the target average
